explanation: Aluminium oxide also reacts with sodium hydroxide like an acid would, forming sodium aluminate and water - demonstrating its amphoteric nature.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A white, insoluble aluminium oxide powder sitting in a colourless sodium hydroxide solution.
beaker_view.final_appearance: A colourless sodium aluminate solution; the white powder has dissolved away.
beaker_view.observation: The same white aluminium oxide powder just as readily dissolves into the alkali, leaving a clear solution — direct evidence that it reacts with both an acid and a base.
